The experience comes first

A page can look simple and still ask the browser to do too much. This article layout leaves room for measurements, trade-offs, and practical examples.

Questions worth asking

  • How quickly can someone read the content?
  • Does the interface respond when they interact?
  • Does the experience still work without animation?
